# Frontend attribution

The graph zoom, fit-to-nodes, force simulation and drag routines in ../graph.js,
and the media card and before/after comparison routines in ../media.js are
adapted from junyeong-nero/tiny-browser-agent:
https://github.com/junyeong-nero/tiny-browser-agent
Files: src/ui/static/graph/graph-render.js and graph-artifacts.js.
Apache-2.0; license retained in tiny-browser-agent-LICENSE.
Modified for SwarmCI: screenshot nodes, event-driven worker positions, shared
paths, artifact URL handling, and accessible media controls.

D3 7.9.0 is distributed locally under its ISC license; see d3-LICENSE.
